scene.placeText: the stone quay of the shining river of her world's island capital on a festival morning — the guild's great river barge with a silver sail moored behind her, boats with silver sails gliding past, the twin-towered cathedral with its glowing rose window on the island across the water and long red-and-blue banners fluttering along the quay

scene.outfit: a river-herald look fitted to her body — a sleeveless doublet of sapphire silk with gold buttons, cut low at the neck, a short pleated skirt of red silk, a silver ship-shaped clasp at her shoulder, leather bracers and laced knee boots
scene.scene: she is the standard-bearer of the river guild of boatmen, striding along the quay at the head of the river procession with the guild's tall standard held upright beside her

prompt:
Use the attached image as the reference: the same adult French woman — the personification of Paris — seen off duty in her everyday life. Keep her face, eye colour, hair colour, skin tone and body exactly; change only her clothes, pose and place. Do not reuse earlier conversation images.

Output: one vertical 2:3 image, 1024×1536.

Face: exactly the attached image's face — the same short midface and face length-to-width ratio; the camera angle, pose, bangs or a headpiece never make her face look longer or her jaw heavier.

Style: Korean MMORPG character artwork. A painterly face with naturally observed facial anatomy, subtle eyelid structure, and soft, realistic shading across the nose and cheeks. 2D painting with visible brushwork: layered strokes of colour, soft broken edges, thin coloured linework and a few crisp accents on the face and costume.
SKIN FINISH: dewy, glass-like highlights on the skin of her shoulders, arms, collarbones and legs — a soft, luminous wet-look sheen that follows the body's forms; her face keeps a soft, natural finish.

She is strikingly beautiful and refined — harmonious features, clear luminous skin, graceful posture — while her own face stays distinct: her face shape, eyes, brows, nose and lips follow the attached image, not a generic pretty face.

World: an ordinary day in Paris as her world knows it — a city of a Western myth-world: carved stone and pale wood, glowing painted patterns, silk, lantern-light and drifting spirit lights, blossoms with softly glowing petals. This is her world's own everyday life, not our present day: every made thing around her — tools, cups, lamps, signs, vehicles, money and devices — is made the way her world makes them.
Let the place itself carry this world through its materials, fittings and objects; do not add the city's landmarks, the moon or a skyline unless the place below names them.

Place: the stone quay of the shining river of her world's island capital on a festival morning — the guild's great river barge with a silver sail moored behind her, boats with silver sails gliding past, the twin-towered cathedral with its glowing rose window on the island across the water and long red-and-blue banners fluttering along the quay
Light direction: side light — the light falls from one side, the far side of her face in soft shadow.
Outfit: a river-herald look fitted to her body — a sleeveless doublet of sapphire silk with gold buttons, cut low at the neck, a short pleated skirt of red silk, a silver ship-shaped clasp at her shoulder, leather bracers and laced knee boots, showing her shoulders, collarbones and legs as far as the outfit allows, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.
Her clothes are her world's everyday dress, not regalia — the chosen outfit keeps its cut, cover and skin, but is made of hand-woven linen, silk, cotton and wool, with laced, tied or hooked closures, embroidered hems and soft leather shoes or boots; nothing synthetic, no zips, no printed logos.
POSTURE: walking.
COMPOSITION: a full-body shot, her complete head, hands and feet inside the frame with restrained margins; body turned three-quarters toward the camera; camera at her eye level; a wall or backdrop of the place close behind her.
Lens / perspective: 35mm-equivalent environmental perspective balancing the woman and the setting with moderate depth.
RIGHT HAND: her own right hand is in PROP.
LEFT HAND: her own left arm hangs relaxed at her side.
PROP: with her own right hand she holds a tall gilded standard topped with a small silver sailing ship riding silver waves, a long pennant of red and blue silk streaming from it at chest height; it is all she holds.
LEGS: mid-stride, one heel lifting.
GAZE: she looks into the camera.
EXPRESSION: heavy-lidded eyes, lips slightly parted and relaxed, brow smooth.
Scene note: she is the standard-bearer of the river guild of boatmen, striding along the quay at the head of the river procession with the guild's tall standard held upright beside her

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most one small accessory.

Light: the place's own light, lit and coloured the way this style renders light and skin.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text, logo or watermark.

Avoid: Nothing from our present day in her world: smartphone, mobile phone, plastic, LED screen, neon sign, neon, laptop, headphones, earbuds, sneakers, hoodie, jeans, hologram, billboard, car, machinery, denim, bomber jacket, cowboy hat, sweatpants, leggings, baseball cap, tracksuit, jogger, track pants, windbreaker, fleece, bodycon, broadcast tower, TV tower, observation tower, skyscraper, Chinese-style palace, Great Wall, yellow-glazed roof tiles.

observations: 은빛 배 문장 군기를 세우고 센강 부두를 걷는다.
선착장의 범선과 물 건너 장미창 성당, 파란 조끼와 붉은 치마가 보인다.
